ANSYS / FEA

FEA

ANSYS FEA

MHD-Propulsion Boat Prototype

Carried out structural analysis for the boat prototype as part of the full design workflow. Hydrostatic pressure was applied to the hull, then total deformation and equivalent (von Mises) stress were checked. The maximum deformation was 0.277 mm and the maximum stress was 1.35 MPa.

ANSYS / CFD

CFD

ANSYS Fluent

Graduation Project: Rotating Packing Cooling Tower

Studied the effect of fill rotation speed on water temperature in ANSYS Fluent using the Discrete Phase Model. The images show particle temperature tracks at rotation speeds from 0 to 25 RPM.

These images are only a small part of a much larger body of work.

ANSYS CFD

MHD-Propulsion Boat Prototype

Performed flow analysis for the boat prototype. The first set of images shows the flow around the hull, and the second shows the flow inside the propulsion channel.
